subtitle: School Management System: multi-tenant web platform for schools, in live pilot
responsibilities: Architected a per-institution multi-tenant data model on Firebase that isolates data across 7 user roles, enforced by about 2,650 lines of Firestore security rules with automated rule tests.

Took the platform from mock-data prototype to live pilot at 1 school, replacing paper registers and grade spreadsheets; shipped 49 feature PRs in under 6 months (gradebook, PDF report cards, online exams).
Cut the entry bundle 88% (3.88 MB to 0.46 MB) and first-load JavaScript 75% (4.53 MB to 1.12 MB) with lazy-loaded routes, and added TanStack Query caching to reduce database reads.

Directed Claude Code agents across 69 merged PRs with written specs and automated guard tests, owning architecture and review; grew the test suite from 3 to 345 files (Vitest, Playwright) in 10 weeks.
Established releases with semantic versioning (now v2.45.0), a changelog and GitHub Actions release and PR checks; led technical direction with 2 developers before becoming sole owner.
